task: Xingpan second batch: 32 symbols, unchanged legacy characters, tabular digits and native small-size raster checks

methods.old_outlines: Exact decomposed same-format outline recordings for every previous glyph including .notdef; complete subset aggregate hashes recorded.
methods.horizontal_metrics: Exact full advance/left-side-bearing tuples for every old hmtx entry; no digit-metric exception applied.
methods.line_metrics: UPM, hhea ascent/descent/lineGap, OS/2 typo ascent/descent/lineGap, and Windows ascent/descent. head.fontRevision is recorded separately as a permitted metadata correction.
methods.rasterization: Pillow/FreeType grayscale at native 11/12/13/14 pixel sizes. WOFF2 is decoded in memory. Require visible ink, advance/line-cell containment with one pixel rounding allowance, and padded paste retaining all grayscale coverage.
methods.refinement_preservation: Exact archived/current glyph-plan dictionaries and source outline recordings for all 161 original refined characters in both weights.

scope_limits: Mechanical nonempty, clipping, line-pattern and mask-distinction checks do not establish subjective legibility or professional hinting acceptance.
Native FreeType device pixels only; browser CSS pixels/DPR, Flutter layout and Android/iOS hardware rasterization are outside this record.
The separate comprehensive verification report covers full-package validation; this incremental check does not rerun that verifier.
Prior geometry review of the 161 locally refined characters is not repeated; source outlines and plans are compared exactly here.

request.intake_hash_scope: Whole document at intake; later status/artifact link updates may change the whole-document hash without changing the requested codepoints.

trigram_raster_semantics.method: Independent Pillow/FreeType actual grayscale masks: occupied horizontal row bands at 25% of strongest row alpha; contiguous horizontal segments at 40% of each band maximum. Read top to bottom independently of the symbol manifest.

star_raster_distinction.method: Independently compare cropped grayscale masks and masks thresholded at alpha >=128 then cropped again; dimensions included in equality.
star_raster_distinction.interpretation: No pair becomes exactly identical within any checked variant/format/size group. Shape-distinction diagnostic only; not subjective readability acceptance.
